knowledge.title: About the Bureau of Indian Standards
knowledge.summary: BIS is India's National Standards Body established under the BIS Act, 2016. Its activities include standards formulation, product certification, compulsory registration, foreign manufacturers certification, hallmarking, laboratory services, consumer activities, training and information services.

knowledge.title: Know Your Standard
knowledge.summary: BIS's Know Your Standard feature lets users search for an Indian Standard by IS number or keyword and access related information such as the standard document, amendments, gazette notifications, scheme of testing and inspection, licence information and laboratories associated with the standard.

knowledge.title: BIS Product Certification Licence — General Process
knowledge.summary: BIS states that the product certification process starts by identifying the applicable Indian Standard. Manufacturers then assess the required manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities. BIS grants a licence after the applicable assessment and conformity requirements are successfully met. Applications are accepted online through the BIS portal.

knowledge.title: BIS Standards Search Portal
knowledge.summary: The official BIS standards portal provides a Know Your Standards search where users can search Indian Standards by number or keywords. The portal also provides links for published standards, new standards, revised standards and other standards-related resources.
